# Let me read the recipes.py file to understand the current implementation
r = await world.call('repo.read_file', path='more_itertools/recipes.py')
content = r['content']

# Find the sieve function
lines = content.split('\n')
in_sieve = False
in_factor = False
sieve_start = None
factor_start = None

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'def sieve(' in line:
        sieve_start = i
        in_sieve = True
    elif 'def factor(' in line:
        factor_start = i
        in_factor = True
    elif in_sieve and line.startswith('def ') and 'def sieve(' not in line:
        print("=== sieve function ===")
        print('\n'.join(lines[sieve_start:i]))
        in_sieve = False
    elif in_factor and line.startswith('def ') and 'def factor(' not in line:
        print("\n=== factor function ===")
        print('\n'.join(lines[factor_start:i]))
        in_factor = False

if in_sieve:
    print("=== sieve function (end of file) ===")
    print('\n'.join(lines[sieve_start:]))
if in_factor:
    print("\n=== factor function (end of file) ===")
    print('\n'.join(lines[factor_start:]))
